The meta-token binds all of these to one canonical identity, content-addressed by hash of its canonical form. Downstream systems (verifier contracts in a Verkle tree, provenance gates that check "was this claim produced under an approved model/tokenizer lineage?") can resolve any token occurrence back to the anchor without knowing which token set produced it.

**SPEC OUTLINE**

Name: MTV-1 (Meta-Token Anchor, profile 1).

§0 Normative references & conventions
- Endianness: little-endian for all integers and field/point coordinates unless stated.
- Hash H = SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4). XOF: SHAKE256 for key derivation stretch? Keep SHA-256 only, use counters.
- Strings: UTF-8, NFC REQUIRED, reject otherwise. Unicode version pinned in descriptor (u32 unicode_major/minor).
- No floats. No locale. No timezone. No wall-clock in any hashed structure (timestamps live in unsigned envelope outside the anchor body).

§1 Data model

MetaTokenAnchor (canonical struct, fixed field order):
```
version      : u8            = 0x01
meaning_type : u8            (1=TEXT_SPAN, 2=URI, 3=LOGICAL_ID, 4=EMBED_DIGEST)
meaning_body : bytes (len u32)
norm_profile : u32           (normalization profile id; 1 = NFC-Unicode<ver>, others registry)
ts_count     : u16
bindings[]   : Binding       (sorted ascending by ts_id bytes; strict, no dupes)
policy_hash  : 32 bytes      (hash of ProvenancePolicy struct)
ext_digest   : 32 bytes      (H of optional extension blob; all-zero = none)
```
Binding:
```
ts_id    : 32 bytes          (tokenizer-set identity)
tok_len  : u32
tokens   : u32[] LE           (token ids; each < vocab_size[ts_id])
span_off : u32               (optional source byte offset; presence flag in ts flags)
flags    : u8                bit0 = span present, bit1 = weights present
weights? : u16[]             (fixed-point weight w/ scale 2^-16, only if bit1)
```
TokenizerDescriptor (hashed to ts_id):
```
family    : u8  (0=BPE,1=UNIGRAM,2=WORDPIECE,3=CHAR,4=REGEX,255=OTHER)
ver_str   : len-u8 bytes ASCII [0-9A-Za-z._-]
vocab_digest: 32 = H(sorted vocab entries, each entry: u32 id || len-u16 bytes token || u8 flags) 
merges_digest: 32 (family-specific canonicalization; zero if n/a)
specials  : canonical list (pad/bos/eos/unk ids as u32)
unicode_ver: u32
```

Tree: 256-ary, key = 32 bytes = stem(31) || suffix(1). Values 32 bytes each. Extension-and-suffix node model per verkle-spec:
- Stem commitment C_s = Pedersen commit Σ_{i=0}^{255} v_i · g_i (zero value ⇒ g_i term omitted; all-zero stem ⇒ C_s = identity).
- Internal node commitment: C_node = Σ_children c_j · ĝ_j over non-empty children (ĝ_j = generator j of the level generator set), level generators from same derivation table (we need ≥256 generators per level; derive 512, use 0..255).
- Root = commitment of top node; serialized 32B LE x-coord (banderwagon x-only).
- Proof: IPA (inner product argument, Bulletproofs-style, Edwards-friendly variant per banderwagon docs) over the opened suffix values; gate verifies with multiproof batching across stems (multi-challenge trick as in verkle-spec).

§6 Provenance gate logic (exact pseudocode)
verify_claim(claim{mt_id?, ts_id, tokens[], policy_ctx}, proof):
1. If mt_id absent: k1 = fwd_key(ts_id,tokens) → open proof → get mt_id (else FAIL_NOANCHOR).
2. k2 = rev_key(mt_id) → open anchor chunks → recompute canon → check H(prefix||canon)==mt_id (else FAIL_BIND).
3. Check binding exists for ts_id and H(token stream) matches claim (else FAIL_TS).
4. policy_hash → resolve policy object (its own chunked blob at derived key) → evaluate predicates (quorum sigs over message = H(gate_domain||root||claim_canon)); expiry via envelope time OUTSIDE hash.
5. Return admit/deny + audit digest = H(root||claim_canon||decision).
Gate is pure: same inputs ⇒ same decision byte; auditors replay offline.
